exposure: Preterm delivery at 35-36 weeks of gestation
preterm delivery at 35-36 weeks of gestation
cohort: 44 patients diagnosed with placenta previa or placenta accreta who underwent cesarean section at King Fahad University Hospital, Al-Khobar, Saudi Arabia, between June 1997 and January 2021.
finding: While univariate analysis identified general anesthesia, placenta accreta, delivery at 35-36 weeks of gestation, and pre-operative anemia as potential risk factors for blood transfusion during cesarean sections for abnormal placentation, these associations were not statistically significant in multivariate analysis.
